description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): create or change a share policy with POST /api/v1/policies or PATCH /api/v1/policies/:id from a website.policy@1. A password arrives in the request body, is hashed with Argon2id and is stored beside the policy, never in the policy document; a write bumps the signed version and tells the edge. The owner and project come from the token, so a body cannot move a policy to another project.
